senses.gloss: उद्-गद्गदिका f. sobbing, Kād. ii, 99, 15.
उद्-गन्धि mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 4, 135) giving forth perfume, fragrant, Ragh.
उद्-गत mfn. gone up, risen, ascended, Ṛtus.; MBh. &c.
come or proceeded forth, appeared, Ratnāv.; Ragh. &c.
gone, departed
extended, large, Ragh.
vomited, cast up, L.
उद्-गता (आ), f. N. of a metre (consisting of four lines, with ten syllables in the first three, and thirteen in the last ; occurring, e.g. in Śiś. xv).
उद्-गत—शृङ्ग mfn. one whose horns are just appearing (as a calf), Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 2, 115.
उद्गतासु mfn. one whose life is gone, deceased, dead.
उद्-गति f. coming forth, Kathās.
going up, rising, ascent, L.
bringing up
vomiting, L.
उद्-ग॑न्तृ m. one who leads out, MaitrUp. vi, 31.
उद्-गम m. going up, rising (of a star &c.), ascending, elevation (of a mountain), R.; Suśr.; Hit.; VarBṛS. &c.
coming forth, becoming visible, appearing, production, origin, Suśr.; Ragh.; Vikr.; Ratnāv. &c.
going out or away, R.; Kathās.; Bhartṛ.
shooting forth (of a plant), Kir.; Kāvyād.
उद्-गमन n. the act of rising (of a star &c.), ascending, Pāṇ. i, 3, 40
the act of coming forth, becoming visible, R.
उद्-गमनीय mfn. to be gone up or ascended, L.
cleansed, clean, Kum. vii, 11; Hcar.
उद्-गमनीय n. a clean cloth or garment, Daś.
a pair of bleached cloths or sheets, L.

उद्-√ गर्ज् P. -गर्जति, to burst out roaring;
to cry out loudly, Kathās.
उद्-गर्जित n. roaring, grunting, Mālatīm.
उद्-गर्भ mfn. pregnant, Vām.
उद्-√ गल् P. -गलति, to trickle out, ooze out, issue in drops, BhP.
उद्-गल mfn. raising the neck, BhP.
उद्-गाल m. vomiting (cf. उद्-गार), L.

उद्-√ गा Ved. P. (aor. or impf. -अगात्) to rise (as the sun &c.), come up, RV.; AV.; TS.; TBr.;
to come forth, begin, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 4, 3.
उद्-गातृ॑ &c. See col. 2.
उद्-गातृ॑ ता, m. one of the four chief-priests (viz. the one who chants the hymns of the Sāmaveda), a chanter, RV. ii, 43, 2; TS.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Suśr.; Mn. &c.
उद्-गार &c. See उद्-√ गॄ below.
उद्-गार m. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 29) the act of discharging, spitting out, ejecting (from the mouth), vomiting, belching, eructation, R.; Suśr.; Ragh.; Megh. &c.
relating repeatedly, Hit.
spittle, saliva, MBh.; Suśr.; Gaut.
flood, high water, R., Kāś. on Pāṇ. iii, 3, 29
roaring, hissing, a loud sound, MBh.; Śāntiś. &c.
उद्-√ गाह् Ā. (pf. 3. pl. -जिगाहीरे [irr.] KātyŚr. xiii, 3, 21) to emerge.
उद्-गाढ mfn. flowing over, excessive, violent, much, Prab.; Sāh.; Bhartṛ. &c.
उद्-गाढम् ind. excessively, much, L.

उद्-√ गुर् P. -गुरते (p. -गुर॑माण, VS. xvi, 46) to raise one's voice in a threatening manner;
to raise (a weapon &c.), lift up, Bhaṭṭ.
उद्-गूरयितृ mfn. threatening, Viṣṇus. v, 60.
उद्-गूर्ण mfn. raised, lifted, held up, Veṇīs.; Pañcat. &c.
erected, excited, W.
raised, exerted, L.
उद्-गूर्ण n. the act of raising (a weapon), threatening, Yājñ. ii, 215.
उद्-गोरण n. the act of raising (a weapon), threatening Comm. on Yājñ. ii, 215.
उद्-√ गुह् P. Ā. -गूहति, -ते, to wind through, twist through, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
उद्-गूहन n. the act of twisting or winding through Comm. on KātyŚr. ii, 7, 2.
उद्-गृभाय See उद्-√ ग्रह्.
उद्-गार—चूडक m. a species of bird, Car.
उद्-गार—शोधन m. black caraway, Bhpr.
उद्-गारिन् mfn. (ifc.) ejecting, spitting, vomiting
discharging, thrusting out, R.; Mṛcch.; Ragh.; Rājat. &c.
uttering, causing to sound, Bālar.
उद्-गारिन् m. the 57th year of the Jupiter cycle, VarBṛS. viii, 50.
उद्-गिरण n. the act of vomiting, ejecting (from the mouth), spitting out, slobbering, slavering, Suśr.; Vedāntas. &c.
उद्-गीर्ण mfn. vomited forth, ejected, Suśr. &c.
cast forth, fallen out of VarBṛS.
caused, effected, Gīt. i, 36.
उद्-गीर्य ind.p. having omitted or ejected &c.
उद्गेही f. a kind of ant, L.
उद्गातु-काम mfn. wishing to sing.
उद्-गातृ—दमन n. N. of several Sāmans.
उद्गात्र्-आदि (˚तृ-आ˚) m. N. of a gaṇa, Pāṇ. v, 1, 129.
उद्-गाथा f. a variety of the Āryā metre (consisting of four lines, containing alternately twelve and eighteen instants).
उद्-गीत mfn. sung
announced, celebrated
उद्-गीत n. singing, a song, MBh.
उद्-गीति f. singing, singing loud
chanting
a variety of the Āryā metre (consisting of four lines of twelve, fifteen, twelve, and eighteen instants).
उद्-गीथ॑ अस्, m. (Uṇ. ii, 10) chanting of the Sāma-veda (especially of the exact Sāma-veda without the additions, the office of the Udgātṛ), AV. xi, 7, 5; xv, 3, 8; TS.; ŚBr.; Lāṭy. &c.
the second part of the Sāma-veda
N. of a son of Bhuva, VP.
of a son of Bhūman (the same?), BhP.
of a commentator of Vedic texts, Sāy.
the syllable ओम् (the triliteral name of God), L.
उद्-गीय ind.p. having sung or chanted &c.
उद्-गेय mfn. to be sung, TāṇḍyaBr.
उद्-ग्रथन n. (v.l. for आ-ग्रथन, Ragh. xix, 41) the act of winding round.
उद्-ग्रथित mfn. tied up
fastened, wound, interlaced
unbound, loosened.

उद्-ग्रथ्य and उद्-ग्रन्थ्य, ind.p. having tied up;
 having wound &c.

उद्-ग्रथ्य and उद्-ग्रन्थ्य, ind.p. having tied up;
 having wound &c.
उद्-ग्रन्थ m. section, chapter, L.
N. of a man (Buddh.)
उद्-ग्रन्थि mfn. untied, free (from worldly ties), BhP.
to comprehend, Divyāv.
उद्-गृहीत mfn. lifted up, taken up, turned up, upraised, Megh. &c.
उद्-गृह्य ind.p. having lifted up
having taken out, ŚBr.
उद्-ग्रभण n. the act of taking up, raising, KātyŚr. xvi, 5, 11.
उद्-ग्र॑हण n. the act of taking out, ŚBr.
recovering (a debt, cf. ऋणोद्ग्र्˚)
taking up, lifting up
describing.
उद्ग्रहणिका f. replying in argument, objection Comm. on BhP. v, 11, 1.
उद्-ग्राहणिका, f. and उद्-ग्राहिणी, f. replying in argument, objection, L.
उद्-ग्राभ॑ अस्, m. taking up, raising, elevating, TS.; VS.
उद्-ग्राह m. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 35) taking up, reception, Uttarar.
‘taking away’, N. of a Sandhi rule (which causes the change of अः, ए, and ओ, to अ before a following vowel), RPrāt. 133
replying in argument, objection, L.
(in music) the introductory part of a piece.
उद्-ग्राह—पद-वृत्ति f. the Udgrāha Sandhi before a long vowel, RPrāt. 134.
उद्-ग्राह—वत् n. a kind of Sandhi (causing the change of आ and अ to अ before ऋ), RPrāt. 136.
उद्-ग्राहणिका, f. and उद्-ग्राहिणी, f. replying in argument, objection, L.
उद्-ग्राहित mfn. taken away, lifted up
deposited, delivered
seized
bound, tied
described, set forth
excellent, exalted
recalled, remembered, recited, L.
उद्-ग्रासक mfn. (√ ग्रस्), devouring, NṛsUp. 203.
उद्-ग्रीव mfn. one who raises or lifts up the neck (in trying to See anything), Amar.; Rājat. &c.
having the neck turned upwards (as a vessel), Kād.
उद्-ग्रीविका f. lifting up the neck, Vās.
उद्ग्रीविन् mfn. raising or lifting up the neck, Śāntiś.
